headline: Democrats swept Congress and NQ ripped ~1,000 pts off a 27,616 overnight low to +0.4% at 28,416, but money is rotating into the Dow and small caps, not tech. Stand aside at the open; go LONG above 28,450, SHORT below Tuesday's 28,305.75 settle.
session_note: Cash open 9:30 AM ET (10:30 AM Atlantic) · morning window · ISM services 10:00 AM ET · no Fed speakers today · NFP Friday

flip.long: LONG on a break and hold of 28,450 (Tuesday's NQ high, ≈ NDX 28,324, just above Tuesday's NDX high 28,308), meaning tech is joining the relief rally. Target the overnight high 28,661.
flip.short: SHORT if NQ loses Tuesday's settle 28,305.75 (≈ NDX 28,180, Tuesday's close), meaning the gap filled and the AI-regulation selling is back. Stronger below the overnight midpoint ~28,139.

thesis: No clear edge for Nasdaq at the open, so stand aside. **Democrats won both the House and Senate**, and NQ first fell as much as 2.4% to **27,615.75, its lowest since July 30**, on fears of AI regulation and higher taxes, then reversed ~930 pts after Trump accepted the results [2,3]. **NQ is +110 pts / +0.39% at 28,415.75 (8:40 AM ET)**, well below its 28,661.25 overnight high [1]. The relief rally is lopsided: Dow futures are +1.8%, Russell +1.6% and S&P +0.9%, while Nasdaq lags at +0.2–0.4% [4]. Megacaps are mixed: AMZN, MSFT and AAPL are up ~2.5–3.5% premarket, but TSLA is −5% on the Texas upsets and NVDA is −1% [1,3]. AMD beat and guided Q4 to ~$17B vs $16.23B expected [5]. Macro is supportive: the 10-year is down to ~4.93%, the dollar index is −0.6% at a one-month low near 101.3, WTI is −2.5% at ~$93.7 and VIX is −12% at ~18.4 [6]. But ADP came in hot at 86K vs ~69K expected and **December hike odds are up to ~77–79%** [7,8]. On Tuesday's ~126-pt futures premium, that implies a cash open near ~28,290 [1]. So **stand aside unless NQ clears 28,450 (long) or loses 28,305.75 (short)**, with ISM services at 10:00.
evidence_cutoff: Wed Nov 4, 2026, 8:52 AM ET (9:52 AM Atlantic). Futures and premarket stock quotes 8:40–8:50 AM ET (Yahoo, may be delayed).

bullets.label: Huge overnight reversal, but NQ is mid-range.
bullets.text: NQ fell to 27,615.75 on the election results, then rallied ~1,000 pts to 28,661.25 and has slipped back to 28,415.75 [1,3]. A ~28,290 implied cash open sits just above Tuesday's NDX close and high. That's an estimate, not a quote.

bullets.label: The rally is a rotation away from tech.
bullets.text: Dow +1.8%, Russell +1.6% and S&P +0.9% vs Nasdaq +0.2–0.4% [4]. Investors are weighing tougher AI oversight, state data-center limits and higher taxes under a Democratic Congress [2,3].

bullets.label: Macro is helpful, the Fed isn't.
bullets.text: Yields, the dollar, oil and VIX are all lower [6]. But ADP beat (86K vs ~69K) and December hike odds rose to ~77–79% [7,8].

bullets.label: Megacaps are split.
bullets.text: AMZN, MSFT and AAPL are up 2.5–3.5%; TSLA is −5% on the Musk trade and NVDA is −1% [1,3]. AMD beat and raised [5].

bullets.label: Bull case:
bullets.text: The political uncertainty is over, Trump struck a conciliatory tone, VIX is down sharply, and yields and the dollar are falling [3,6]. Futures already absorbed the worst-case reaction overnight and bought it hard. Holding above Tuesday's high could squeeze toward 28,661.

bullets.label: Bear case:
bullets.text: Tech is lagging the rest of the market, and AI regulation fears were the reason for the overnight crash [2]. NQ has already faded ~245 pts from its high. A strong ISM on top of ADP could lift yields and hike odds, and the NDX is still in a correction.

bullets.label: Flip to LONG:
bullets.text: NQ breaks and holds above 28,449.50 (≈ NDX 28,324) in the first 30 minutes, ideally with the 10-year staying under 4.95% after ISM.

bullets.label: Flip to SHORT:
bullets.text: NQ loses Tuesday's settle 28,305.75 (≈ NDX 28,180), filling the gap. Stronger below the overnight midpoint ~28,139.

bullets.label: Stay STAND ASIDE:
bullets.text: NQ chops between 28,305.75 and 28,450 while money rotates into cyclicals and small caps.

bullets.label: Wildcards:
bullets.text: ISM services at 10:00 AM ET (est. 54.8), US–Iran headlines and oil, more midterm-policy headlines on AI and taxes, and Fed speakers Thursday (Hammack, Barkin, Logan) [7,9].
